checks.question: Which collective bargaining agreement (Kollektivvertrag) applies, and what classification (Einstufung) is agreed?
Is there an all-in or overtime lump-sum clause, and is the base salary shown separately (§ 2g AVRAG)?
What probation period and contract term (fixed or indefinite) are agreed?
What notice periods and termination dates apply, and do they deviate from statute or the CBA?
Is there a non-compete clause (Konkurrenzklausel), and does it meet §§ 2c AVRAG / 36 AngG (salary threshold, maximum one year, penalty limit)?
Is there a training-cost repayment clause, and does it meet § 2d AVRAG?
Are there forfeiture periods (Verfallsfristen) for claims?
Who owns work results and inventions (PatG employee inventions, UrhG)?
What confidentiality obligations apply during and after employment?
